plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Plant Science map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The program has ONE pathway, 'to Degree', transcribed in full as the program's sole published map; there is no 'to CSU' pathway for this credential in the 2026-2027 mapper. This is the Plant Science AS, a distinct credential from the Agriculture Plant Science AS-T collected in an earlier wave; the mapper's catalog-year selector also lists a Plant Science Certificate of Achievement under the same name, which was not used. The map prints the degree total as a range, 60-61.5 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 15 / 15 / 15. The only ranged slot is Term 1 '1.A. English Communication (BC)' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention it is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. Unlike the to-CSU maps, this map uses Bakersfield College local GE areas (marked '(BC)'), transcribed exactly as printed. CRPS B5, AGRI B1 and AGBS B6 are each printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; all are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. CRPS B48WE is printed at 2 units, recorded as printed. The Term 2 mathematics slot title is printed '2. Mathematics or Quantitative Reason (BC)' (spelled 'Reason', not 'Reasoning'), transcribed as printed. General-education slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. No row on the map shows a 'Prerequisites' flag (the word does not appear on the map page in either view), so no prereqs are recorded. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.' (This to-Degree map's disclaimer wording differs from the to-CSU maps' wording.)
